output.summary: DBS, OCBC and UOB jointly completed first live SGD tokenised-deposit interbank transactions on Swift's ledger on 10 Sep; no unilateral move peers must follow found.

sources.title: First blockchain-enabled SGD transactions (DBS, OCBC, UOB)
sources.quote: DBS, OCBC and UOB completed live domestic Singapore dollar interbank transactions using tokenised deposits on Swift's blockchain-based ledger.

sources.title: Singapore Banks After the Fed Rate Hike: DBS, OCBC & UOB in Q4 2026
sources.quote: DBS has explicitly quantified its rate sensitivity at approximately S$11 million in net interest income per basis point of SGD rate movement.

sources.title: Jefferies Starts Singapore Banks With Buy on DBS and UOB, Hold on OCBC
